_comment: AI-chat provider config for the deployed server (Railway). Chosen with LLM_CONFIG=llm_config.deploy.json.
_security: NEVER put a real key in this file. The key lives in the GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable.
_why: A deployed server has no terminal, so llm_config.json cannot be created by pasting a key in Settings. A committed config with no secret in it is the reproducible answer.
